backend/main.mo: Implements access‑controlled user profiles and product management, including CRUD for profiles and admin‑only product creation with metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature evidence entries linking features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short descriptions of various frontend source files for documentation or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes with unified styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint loading root React app and including CDN scripts for jsPDF and JSZip.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application controller managing authentication, onboarding, view switching, and product bundle workflow.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides login/logout button with Internet Identity integration and accessibility-aware labeling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for capturing and saving a new user's name during initial setup.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: Global React error boundary that displays a recovery UI and optional dev-only error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Provides a multi-tab instructional guide explaining how to use the app, customize products, generate outputs, and prepare them for sale.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Displays generated product bundles and allows downloading individual PDFs, ZIPs, or a combined ZIP with error handling and size formatting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header navigation, authentication-aware buttons, and view-specific actions like export and preview.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Shows a modal onboarding flow containing ExportInstructions and a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Renders an iframe preview of a product PDF or an alert if no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Displays all products with cover images, descriptions, and embedded PDF previews, supporting expandable text and navigation back.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Lists expected ZIP file contents for a product, including PDFs, assets, templates, checklists, and prompts.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Provides a form-based UI to edit product fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with handlers for adding, updating, and removing items. Includes a generate button tied to external generation logic.
Manages a collection of products, draft persistence, backend population, and individual or batch generation flows. Coordinates product editing, default resets, and error handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover, truncated description, expand/collapse behavior, and an edit button. Used for storefront browsing and quick navigation to editing.
Renders a storefront grid of default products with an option to navigate back to the editor. Each product is displayed using StorefrontProductCard and supports edit actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity, reinitializing on identity changes. Invalidates dependent queries to ensure fresh data after actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state, login/logout actions, and persisted identity loading via Internet Identity. Wraps AuthClient setup and exposes status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Tracks whether onboarding instructions have been seen using localStorage. Exposes modal open/close logic and auto-open behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/usePopulateDefaultPro: Exposes admin check and mutation to repopulate default products via the backend. Invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and save the caller’s user profile through the backend actor. Uses react-query for caching and automatic invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, light/dark theme CSS variables, base styles, and utility classes including a workspace accent bar.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Provides default product entries with metadata, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utility functions to trigger browser downloads for blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-tagged filenames for PDFs and ZIP bundles.
frontend/src/lib/generation/formatGenera: Formats generation errors into user messages and logs detailed error info.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Sequentially generates bundles for multiple products and reports progress.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a full product bundle by fetching the cover, generating the PDF, and assembling a ZIP.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generationEr: Defines a typed GenerationError class for structured error handling during bundle generation.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages saving, loading, and resetting product drafts in localStorage with versioning.
Creates a multi‑page PDF for a product using jsPDF, including cover, description, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/pdf/jspdfClient.ts: Provides safe access to the jsPDF library loaded from CDN and helpers to create documents.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing individual product ZIPs and a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Creates a product ZIP including its PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/jszipClient.ts: Provides safe access to the JSZip library loaded from CDN and a helper to create ZIP instances.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Provides functions that return README section strings for app usage and upload instructions for Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project state metadata including versions, known issues, and feature definitions.
